body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

## Benchmark

<details open>

<summary>PC specifications</summary>

- **CPU:** Intel Core i9-13900K
- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090
- **RAM:** 64 GB (2×32 GB DDR5-5800 C30)
- **SSD:** Solidigm P44 Pro 2 TB
- **OS:** Linux (Fedora 42)
</details>

Using an optimized editor build (`production=yes lto=full`)
and the benchmark from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/104372#issuecomment-2738253818.

`master`:

```
add 50000: 54ms
rem 50000: 21ms
add 500000: 601ms
rem 500000: 253ms
add 1000000: 1447ms
rem 1000000: 762ms
```

This PR:

```
add 50000: 49ms
rem 50000: 20ms
add 500000: 485ms
rem 500000: 236ms
add 1000000: 1006ms
rem 1000000: 694ms
```
Wow, that's way less invasive than I thought it would be! After a rebase, this'll be good to go
